verdict.rationale: Devin supports several built-in automatic triggers—Auto-Fix responding to PR review comments/CI failures, Devin Review firing on pull requests, CI/CD pipeline integration reacting to static-analysis findings, and MCP-based scheduling/session management—which amounts to event-driven automation, but these are fixed product features rather than a general user-defined rule/condition-action system. missing for 10: an explicit rules/condition builder or webhook-based custom trigger configuration, documentation of arbitrary event types beyond PR/CI/chat mentions, and independent evidence confirming these automations run reliably unattended.
